candidate_name: Hoosier #1 Landfill soil-cover and composite-cover closures

why_promising.matching_visible_surface_by_design: Both the older closure plan and the 2009 partial-closure report specify approximately 30 inches of protective soil below a 6-inch vegetative layer.
why_promising.public_coordinate_system: Indiana State Plane Coordinates, East Zone

additional_evidence: Final Cover Survey Results table with coordinates and actual subgrade, top-of-soil-barrier and top-of-cover elevations.
Thickness Verification Results table with coordinate-tied soil-barrier and protective-soil thicknesses.
Coordinate-labelled final-cover as-built drawing comparing design and as-built final grades.

fatal_blockers: The 18 coordinate-tied measurements vary irregularly among toe, mid-slope and crest locations and do not define two separate broad shallow/deep polygons.
The measured 1.85-acre south-slope area is a long, boundary-constrained strip; the public evidence does not prove two independent 30-40 m clean interiors after margins.

The older approximately 39.1-acre soil-cover closure is documented through design and post-closure plans, but the recovered public file does not publish final coordinate-tied measured cover thicknesses.
The full approximately 27-acre composite area has an as-built final-grade map, but the public package does not provide an absolute subgrade-to-final thickness grid covering the full area.
The recovered records do not state numerical horizontal or vertical survey uncertainty.
Final equivalence of soil source, gradation, compaction and radar-facing moisture behavior between the older and newer cover areas is not proven.
sources_reviewed: Certification of Partial Closure Report, Cell 1 South Slope, 1.85 Acres, May 2009.
2008 Final Closure certification drawing set and as-built final-cover drawings.
Revised Solid Waste Closure and Post-Closure Plan, October 1996.
IDEM VFC public records recovered through temporary PR #18.
next_action: Continue the approved search unchanged for a full-scale vegetated closure package that publishes two coordinate-tied broad final measured depth zones, numerical uncertainty, matching final upper-soil construction and a stable Sentinel-1 period.
